name: period
meaning: Square periodic cell

name: disc_r
meaning: Disc radius; disc-via rim clearance must pass

name: slot_l
meaning: Slot length along y

name: slot_w
meaning: Slot width across x

name: island_l
meaning: Island length along y (2.0 mm lower bound: short islands raise the island resonance; user-required 3.5/3.0/2.5/2.0 rows)

name: island_w
meaning: Island width across x; left edge tied to fixed 0.30 diode gap (island shifted toward diode slot edge)

name: island_offset
meaning: Longitudinal island centre y; x centre derived from slot width and fixed gap

name: diode_pos
meaning: Diode centre y relative to island centre

name: diode_gap
meaning: BAR90-02LRH pad gap = sheet length across x FIXED (datasheet p.7)

name: diode_w
meaning: Sheet width along y = pad length FIXED; sheet W/L = diode_w/diode_gap = 2.0

name: pad_w
meaning: Diode copper pad width across x FIXED (TSLP-2-7 footprint)

name: pad_l
meaning: Diode copper pad length along y FIXED (TSLP-2-7 footprint)

name: island_via_x
meaning: Island via x = island centroid (derived per row by generate_sweeps; nominal island x -1.15..+0.15)

name: island_via_y
meaning: Island via y = island centroid = island_offset (derived per row by generate_sweeps)

name: disc_via_x
meaning: Global x of disc via

name: disc_via_y
meaning: Global y of disc via

name: via_drill
meaning: Solid PEC via diameter matching calibration; no separate plating model

name: pad_dia
meaning: Bottom pad diameter; radial annular ring at least 0.15

name: antipad_dia
meaning: Ground anti-pad diameter; 0.6 mm is the minimum fabricable with the 0.3 mm drill and the 0.15 mm rule (0.4 mm dropped by user decision)

name: fr4_t
meaning: FR4 thickness below ground

name: stub_l
meaning: Two bottom bias stubs directed positive y (stub 0 = separate nostub project)

name: stub_w
meaning: Bottom stub width across x

name: trace_w
meaning: Periodic bias trace width on FR4 bottom (trace variant only)

name: rt_t
meaning: RT5880 thickness FIXED

name: cu_t
meaning: PEC solid thickness FIXED

name: air_top
meaning: PEC lid global z FIXED

name: air_below
meaning: Radiation boundary distance below lowest metal FIXED

name: mesh_rt
meaning: Initial RT maximum element length

name: mesh_metal
meaning: Initial top-metal maximum element length

name: mesh_fine
meaning: Diode via and anti-pad maximum element length

name: mesh_fr4
meaning: Initial FR4 maximum element length

name: $ph_x
meaning: Across x phase

name: $ph_y
meaning: Along y phase

name: Rs
meaning: Impedance sheet resistance; OFF nominal (BAR90, 5.8 GHz, W/L 2)

name: Xs
meaning: Impedance sheet reactance; OFF nominal; 0.4 nH series L included
